brief:
Mujahed Al-Saadi, a Palestinian journalist, has documented his experience during 22 months in Israeli detention following his arrest from his home in Jenin two years ago, Drop Site News reported. Al-Saadi's account details conditions he characterizes as involving cruelty, deprivation, and indignity during his time in custody.

The journalist's firsthand testimony adds to growing accounts from Palestinians held in Israeli prisons regarding detention conditions and treatment.
dek: Palestinian journalist Mujahed Al-Saadi documents his harrowing experience in Israeli detention two years after being arrested from his home in Jenin.
title: Palestinian journalist describes 22 months in Israeli detention
